items.title: The Los Angeles Clippers and Jalen Pickett have agreed to a two-way deal, league sources told HoopsHype. The 26-year-old guard spent the past three seasons with the Denver Nuggets where he shot 39% from 3-point range. Pickett was the 32nd pick of the 2023 NBA Draft.
items.author: Michael Scotto
items.body_excerpt: The Los Angeles Clippers and Jalen Pickett have agreed to a two-way deal, league sources told HoopsHype. The 26-year-old guard spent the past three seasons with the Denver Nuggets where he shot 39% from 3-point range. Pickett was the 32nd pick of the 2023 NBA Draft.
